data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 asserts a 'dependence' relation but fails to name what kind of dependence it is. The problem requires proposing a SUBSTANTIVE relation 'naming its kind' — the target says 'DEPENDS ON the causal mechanism' then immediately recharacterizes it as 'abstracts ... into a two-component additive model,' which is an abstraction relation, not a dependence. The artifact oscillates between two relation kinds without committing to one, leaving the substantive relation ambiguous. Furthermore, 'causally unrelated' in the refutation clause is undefined: mathematical equivalence of two arithmetic decompositions is not a causal dependence in any standard sense — $909 as a number does not 'depend on' the piecewise method; it can be derived independently. The relation is one of reduction/equivalence, not dependence.
